title: Logical Reasoning
description: Class 7 IMO — Logical Reasoning: analogy, classification and number series, advanced coding-decoding, direction sense, Venn diagrams, and mathematical puzzles like magic squares and number pyramids.

topics.title: Analogy, Classification & Series
topics.concept: In a series, find the rule (the differences may themselves form a pattern) and give the next term. In an analogy, match the relationship of the first pair. In classification (odd one out), spot the item that breaks the rule.
recap: Series: find the rule (even in the differences).
Analogy: match the relationship; classification: find the odd one out.

quiz.q: Which is the odd one out: 3, 5, 7, 9?
quiz.explanation: 9 = 3 × 3 is composite; the others are prime.

topics.title: Coding-Decoding (Advanced)
topics.concept: In coding-decoding, letters change by a rule — shifting by a fixed number, or using position values (A = 1 … Z = 26). Find the rule from the example, then apply it.

examples.problem: If each letter moves forward by 2, what is the code for CAT?
If A = 1, B = 2, …, what is the value of D?

recap: Find the shift or the position rule, then apply it.

quiz.q: If each letter moves forward by 2, the code for DOG is ___ ?
If A = 1, B = 2, …, Z = 26, the value of the letter D is ___ ?

topics.title: Direction Sense, Venn Diagrams & Puzzles
topics.concept: For direction sense, use the compass clockwise: North, East, South, West. A Venn diagram shows the overlap of groups. A 3×3 magic square using 1 to 9 has every line summing to 15, and in a number pyramid each brick is the sum of the two below it.

examples.problem: Facing South, you turn right. Which way do you face?
In a number pyramid, the bricks below are 3 and 4. What is the brick above?

recap: Compass clockwise: North, East, South, West.
Magic square (1–9) line sum = 15; pyramid brick = sum of the two below.

quiz.q: In a 3×3 magic square using 1 to 9, each line sums to ___ ?
Facing North and turning right, you now face ___ ?
quiz.explanation: Turning right from North faces East.

questions.q: Which is the odd one out: 11, 13, 15, 17?
questions.explanation: 15 = 3 × 5 is composite; the others are prime.

questions.q: If each letter moves forward by 2, the code for CAT is ___ ?
If A = 1, B = 2, …, Z = 26, the value of the letter D is ___ ?
Facing North, you turn right and then right again. Which way do you face?
questions.explanation: Two right turns from North face South.

questions.q: In a 3×3 magic square using 1 to 9, each line sums to ___ ?
In a number pyramid, the bricks below are 3 and 4. The brick above is ___ ?
questions.explanation: Each brick is the sum of the two below: 3 + 4 = 7.
Each term is the sum of the two before: 3 + 5 = 8.

questions.q: A clock shows 3:00. What is the angle between the hands?
Riya walks 4 km North, then 3 km further North. How far North is she from the start?
In a 3×3 magic square using 1 to 9, what number is in the centre?
questions.explanation: The centre of this magic square is always 5.
